1. Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized **Project Billing & Site Administration Executive** to manage project billing, commercial documentation, site administration, expense tracking, and MIS reporting. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating with project execution teams, vendors, subcontractors, Finance, HR, Procurement, Stores, and Head Office to ensure accurate billing, timely documentation, effective administrative support, and smooth project operations.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Billing and Commercial Activities**

* Prepare and maintain client Running Account (RA) bills, invoices, measurement sheets, and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with the project execution team to collect work completion reports, measurement records, and other billing-related documents.
* Prepare and verify subcontractor and vendor bills against approved work orders, BOQs, measurements, and work completion status.
* Maintain records of client billing, vendor billing, payment status, outstanding amounts, and pending approvals.
* Follow up with clients, Commercial, Finance, and Project Management teams for bill submission, certification, and payment processing.
* Assist in preparing reconciliation statements, debit notes, credit notes, and billing summaries.
* Maintain documentation related to GST invoices, e-invoices, delivery challans, and other commercial documents, as applicable.
* Track variations, extra items, additional works, and approved changes in project scope for billing purposes.
* Support monthly billing forecasts and outstanding payment reports.

**B. Site Administration**

* Manage day-to-day site office administration and ensure the availability of essential office supplies and resources.
* Maintain employee attendance, manpower deployment records, leave records, and timesheets.
* Coordinate guest house accommodation, electricity bills, rent payments, transportation, vehicle deployment, and other site-related expenses.
* Maintain petty cash records, expense statements, travel claims, and reimbursement documents.
* Coordinate with HR and Administration regarding employee joining formalities, documentation, and site requirements.
* Maintain records of site access passes, employee IDs, safety induction documentation, and other compliance requirements, as applicable.

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports related to billing, expenses, manpower, vendor payments, and pending activities.
* Maintain systematic physical and digital records of project correspondence, approvals, invoices, and commercial documents.
* Regularly update billing trackers, payment trackers, expense statements, and document registers.

* Ensure timely submission of required reports to Head Office and concerned departments.
* Maintain proper records for internal reviews, audits, and management reporting.

**D. Coordination and Follow-up**

* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Procurement, Stores, Finance, HR, Commercial, and Head Office teams.
* Follow up on pending bills, payment approvals, vendor documentation, and administrative requirements.
* Ensure timely escalation of unresolved billing, documentation, and administration issues that may affect project progress.
* Support internal and external audits by providing the required records and supporting documents.
* Ensure effective communication between the project site and Head Office for smooth project operations.

3. Required Qualifications

* Graduate in Commerce (B.Com), Business Administration (BBA), or any relevant discipline.
* Candidates with qualifications in Civil, Electrical, or other engineering disciplines may also be considered if they have relevant billing and commercial experience.
* Knowledge of project billing, RA bills, BOQ, measurement sheets, GST invoices, and commercial documentation is preferred.

4. Required Experience

* Relevant experience in project billing, commercial activities, site administration, or project coordination in an EPC, MEP, electrical, IT infrastructure, data centre, or construction company.

* Familiarity with RA billing, BOQ, measurement sheets, invoices, and payment tracking.
* Good documentation, record-keeping, and data management skills.
* Strong coordination, follow-up, and communication abilities.

* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet reporting deadlines.

* Ability to coordinate independently with site teams and Head Office.

* Accuracy and regular updating of billing, payment, expense, and manpower trackers.

description:
**Senior Project Manager | Solutionara Private Limited**  
Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (On-site, Sector 62 GDC) | Experience: 8–12 years | Full-time, Permanent  
Compensation: ₹16 LPA – ₹26 LPA (CTC)

**About Solutionara**

Solutionara is a U.S.-based IT Consulting and Technology Services firm with a Global Delivery Center (GDC) in Noida, India. We are a fast-scaling firm that operates with high ownership, lean teams, and disciplined execution, and we are evolving toward an AI-enabled delivery model focused on enterprise integration, digital transformation, and scalable technology solutions for global clients.

**The Role**

We are seeking an experienced, technically proficient, client-facing Senior Project Manager to own complex technology engagements and deliver committed business outcomes. This is more than project coordination, status reporting, or Agile ceremony management. You will translate client objectives and agreed scope into executable delivery plans, drive cross-functional teams toward measurable outcomes, proactively resolve risks and dependencies, and maintain strong client confidence throughout the engagement lifecycle.

You will be the primary delivery counterpart for assigned client engagements, working closely with Solution Architects, Technical Leads, Developers, Integration and Data Engineers, QA, DevOps, Business Analysts, client stakeholders, and external vendors.

**Success is measured by delivered and accepted outcomes, predictable execution, quality, and stakeholder confidence — not simply by activities completed or reports produced.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-end delivery:** Own projects/workstreams from initiation and planning through engineering, testing, deployment, stabilization, and closure. Translate SOWs and client commitments into delivery plans with milestones, owners, timelines, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* **Client-facing leadership:** Lead client delivery meetings, milestone reviews, governance discussions, and executive status presentations. Communicate project health transparently and manage challenging conversations on risks, changing priorities, and missed commitments.
* **Technical coordination:** Coordinate delivery involving enterprise applications, cloud platforms, APIs, middleware, data platforms, digital portals, and legacy modernization. Understand architecture, interfaces, data flows, and deployment requirements well enough to identify risks and challenge assumptions.
* **Governance, risk & dependencies:** Maintain project plans, WBS, milestone trackers, RAID logs, decision registers, dependency trackers, and delivery dashboards. Escalate material risks early with facts, impact assessments, and recommended options; lead recovery planning for at-risk engagements.
* **Outcome-based delivery:** Track progress against committed deliverables and business outcomes, not just task completion. Validate completion with evidence and convert unclear status updates into specific commitments, owners, and next actions.
* **Scope & commercial awareness:** Track effort and utilization against plan, identify scope expansion, prepare change-impact assessments, and escalate changes through approved governance. (This role does not carry sales targets, account revenue, contracting, or P&L ownership.)
* **Quality, release & acceptance:** Coordinate SIT, regression, UAT, defect management, go-live readiness, cutover, rollback planning, hypercare, and transition to support.
* **Reporting & executive communication:** Prepare concise, decision-oriented updates for clients and Solutionara leadership; translate technical challenges into business impact.
* **PMO maturity:** Improve delivery governance, templates, reporting standards, and playbooks using Jira, Asana, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
* **AI-enabled delivery:** Use approved AI and automation tools responsibly to improve planning, documentation, reporting, and risk identification — validating outputs for accuracy and confidentiality.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in project management, technical delivery management, or enterprise technology delivery.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing client-facing IT consulting or technology delivery engagements.
* Experience managing distributed, cross-functional teams across engineering, QA, DevOps, architecture, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Practical experience with project plans, milestone tracking, RAID management, dependency registers, scope control, and executive reporting.
* Experience managing client expectations, escalations, project changes, and delivery recovery plans.
* Strong written and verbal English communication, including client-facing presentations.
* Ability to operate independently, create structure in ambiguity, and drive accountability across stakeholders.
* Willingness to work on-site at our Noida GDC and collaborate with US-based client and leadership teams as required.

**Preferred Experience**

* Enterprise Integration (Dell Boomi, MuleSoft, Workato, APIs, EDI/B2B), Enterprise Applications (ERP, CRM, JDE, WMS), Cloud & DevOps (AWS, Azure, CI/CD), Data Platforms (CDP, PIM, DAM, analytics), Digital Applications (customer/dealer portals, commerce), or Modernization Programs.
* Managing US or international clients through onsite-offshore delivery models.
* Coordinating multiple vendors, client SMEs, and geographically distributed teams.
* Supporting complex enterprise releases, cutovers, and hypercare.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum, or other recognized project management certification.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted project management and productivity tools.

Prior experience with every listed platform is not required — we value sufficient technical understanding and learning agility to manage complex technology delivery.

**Ideal Candidate**

A hands-on, technically aware, client-oriented delivery leader who can explain not only what was done, but what was delivered, how success was validated, and what risks were overcome. Proactive rather than reactive, transparent rather than overly optimistic, and able to maintain client confidence even when challenges arise.

**Why Join Solutionara?**

* Work on enterprise technology transformation initiatives for global clients.
* Gain exposure to cloud, integration, data platforms, application modernization, and AI-enabled delivery.
* Take meaningful ownership of client-facing technology engagements.
* Collaborate directly with technical specialists, delivery leadership, and international stakeholders.
* Help build scalable delivery governance within a growing Global Delivery Center.
* A culture that values accountability, transparency, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.
